# Media

The media library: the upload door (a file as base64 in `data`), each file's words (alt text, caption, credit), its folder, and replacing a file in use. media.add and media.replaceBlob record bytes the upload route stored: send media.uploadFile instead.

[`media.add`](#mediaadd) · [`media.remove`](#mediaremove) · [`media.setMeta`](#mediasetmeta) · [`media.move`](#mediamove) · [`media.replaceBlob`](#mediareplaceblob) · [`mediaFolder.create`](#mediafoldercreate) · [`mediaFolder.rename`](#mediafolderrename) · [`mediaFolder.move`](#mediafoldermove) · [`mediaFolder.delete`](#mediafolderdelete) · [`media.uploadFile`](#mediauploadfile)

## media.add

Put a file in the media library: its stored URL, type and kind, its facts and, optionally, its alt text, caption, credit and folder. It records a file whose bytes are already stored and uploads nothing: the upload route sends it once it has stored them. Refused: `media.exists` (the id is taken), `media.mime` (a type the library does not take: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, SVG, MP4, WebM, PDF; a type that is not the kind said; a blob of another type), `mediaFolder.unknown` (no such folder).

- **not offered to agents**: the `media.uploadFile` door sends it, and a batch that sends it is refused naming that door; class `content`.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | A new uuid you choose for the file. |
| `entry` | { filename: string (min 1, max 512), contentType: string (min 1, max 255), size?: integer ≥0 \| null, url: string (min 1, max 2048), storageKey?: string (max 1024) \| null, kind: "image" \| "svg" \| "video" \| "document", width?: integer \| null, height?: integer \| null, pageCount?: integer \| null, variants?: { url: string (… (the whole schema: discover_operations with names) | yes | The stored file: filename, contentType and kind (image, svg, video, document; they must agree), url where it is stored, its facts (size, width, height, renditions) and optionally alt, caption, credit and folderId. |

Example input:

```json
{"id":"3e9b6c2a-7f14-4d58-a0c3-8b2e5f9d1a47","entry":{"filename":"lavori-via-dei-gracchi-02.webp","contentType":"image/webp","kind":"image","size":40898,"width":750,"height":467,"storageKey":null,"url":"/api/blueprint-assets/archiplan/images/photos/lavori-via-dei-gracchi-02.webp","alt":{"it":"Cantiere in via dei Gracchi","en":"Building site on Via dei Gracchi"},"credit":"Studio Archiplan","folderId":"b7d4e1a9-5c3f-4a82-9e06-2d8f1b6c4a35"}}
```

## media.remove

Take a file out of the media library when nothing shows it; its bytes stay stored, so the undo brings it back whole. Refused: `media.unknown`, `media.inUse` (a page, a component, a collection item, a page's listing or social picture, the SEO default, or the site's icon or logo names it, by reference or by its address; the refusal names where: take it out there first, or give it a new file with media.replaceBlob), `media_legacy` (an entry its undo could not add back).

- **op**; class `content` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | The media file, by its id (the media read lists the library). |

Example input:

```json
{"id":"3e9b6c2a-7f14-4d58-a0c3-8b2e5f9d1a47"}
```

## media.setMeta

Set what an author edits of a media file: its alt text and caption (one, or one per locale), credit, name in the library and focal point. A field given is written whole (null clears it); `unset` takes a field off; fields left out stay. Every place that shows the file reads this alt, but a part that holds its own alt (its alt prop) shows that one: clear it with tree.set_props alt null in the same batch. Refused: `media.unknown`, `media.locale` (a locale the site does not have), `invalid_input` (nothing to set or unset).

- **op**; class `content` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "picture", "image", "photo", "alt".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | The media file, by its id (the media read lists the library). |
| `alt` | string (max 500) \| Record<string, string (max 500)> \| null |  | Its text alternative, written whole: one text, or one per locale, every locale it keeps (read the entry first and change one); null: none. |
| `caption` | string (max 1000) \| Record<string, string (max 1000)> \| null |  | Its caption, written whole: one text, or one per locale, every locale it keeps; null: none. |
| `credit` | string (max 512) \| null |  | Who to credit for it (a photographer, an agency); null: none. |
| `filename` | string (min 1, max 512) |  | Its name in the library. |
| `focal` | { x: number ≥0 ≤1, y: number ≥0 ≤1 } \| null |  |  |
| `unset` | ("alt" \| "caption" \| "credit" \| "filename" \| "focal")[] |  | Fields taken off the entry altogether (null keeps the field, empty); the undo of a first write uses it. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"id":"3e9b6c2a-7f14-4d58-a0c3-8b2e5f9d1a47","alt":{"it":"Cantiere in via dei Gracchi, Roma","en":"Building site on Via dei Gracchi, Rome"}}
```
```json
{"id":"3e9b6c2a-7f14-4d58-a0c3-8b2e5f9d1a47","credit":"Foto di Luca Ferri","focal":{"x":0.4,"y":0.35}}
```

## media.move

Put media files in a folder, or at the top level of the library (folderId null). Refused: `media.unknown` (an id names no file), `mediaFolder.unknown` (no such folder).

- **op**; class `content` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mediaIds` | uuid[] (≤200) | yes | The media files, by id (the media read lists them). |
| `folderId` | uuid \| null | yes | The folder they go in, by id; null: the top level of the library. |

Example input:

```json
{"mediaIds":["3e9b6c2a-7f14-4d58-a0c3-8b2e5f9d1a47","007ea978-bc56-486a-a2df-b658f693ce87"],"folderId":"b7d4e1a9-5c3f-4a82-9e06-2d8f1b6c4a35"}
```

## media.replaceBlob

Replace the file of a media entry with another one of the same kind, keeping its id, so every page, component and item that shows it shows the new file. Its alt text, caption, credit, name and folder stay. Use it instead of removing a file that is in use. Refused: `op_target` (no such entry), `media_kind` (a picture is replaced by a picture, a video by a video), `invalid_input` (the blob's type is not the file's), `media_legacy` (an entry whose old file fields could not be put back by its undo).

- **not offered to agents**: the `media.uploadFile` door sends it, and a batch that sends it is refused naming that door; class `content`.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | The media file, by its id (the media read lists the library). |
| `file` | object | yes | The new file whole, as the upload stored it: its url, contentType, size, width and height, renditions (variants) and blob; a field left out is removed from the entry. |
| `file` › `blob` | { hash: string, bytes: integer ≥0, contentType: string (min 1, max 255) } |  |  |
| `file` › `url` | string (min 1, max 2048) | yes |  |
| `file` › `storageKey` | string (max 1024) \| null |  |  |
| `file` › `contentType` | string (min 1, max 255) | yes |  |
| `file` › `size` | integer ≥0 \| null |  |  |
| `file` › `pageCount` | integer \| null |  |  |
| `file` › `width` | integer \| null |  |  |
| `file` › `height` | integer \| null |  |  |
| `file` › `variants` | { url: string (min 1, max 2048), mime: string (min 1, max 255), width: integer, height?: integer, bytes?: integer ≥0 }[] \| null |  |  |
| `file` › `contentBox` | { x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number } \| null |  |  |

| `file` › `svgInline` | string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …>)[] \| Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …>> \| null |  |  |

Example input:

```json
{"id":"3e9b6c2a-7f14-4d58-a0c3-8b2e5f9d1a47","file":{"url":"/api/media/archiplan/lavori-via-dei-gracchi-02-v2.webp","storageKey":"archiplan/media/lavori-via-dei-gracchi-02-v2.webp","contentType":"image/webp","size":52310,"width":1600,"height":996}}
```

## mediaFolder.create

Add a media folder: its name, at the top level of the library or under a folder. Put files in it with media.move. Refused: `mediaFolder.exists` (the id is taken), `mediaFolder.unknown` (no such parent), `mediaFolder.name` (a folder of that name is already there).

- **op**; class `content` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | uuid | yes | A new uuid you choose for the folder. |
| `name` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes | The folder's name: no "/", unique among the folders beside it. |
| `parentId` | uuid \| null | yes | The folder it goes under, by id; null: the top level of the library. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"id":"b7d4e1a9-5c3f-4a82-9e06-2d8f1b6c4a35","name":"Cantieri","parentId":null}
```
```json
{"id":"1a6c9e3d-8b2f-4d71-a5e0-7c3b9f2d6e18","name":"Via dei Gracchi","parentId":"b7d4e1a9-5c3f-4a82-9e06-2d8f1b6c4a35"}
```


## media.uploadFile

Upload a file into the media library (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG, MP4, WebM or PDF) with its folder, alt text, caption and credit; with `replaces` (a media id) the file becomes the new file of that entry, which keeps its words and folder, so every use follows. Alone in a batch. The file travels as base64 in `data`, at most 20 MB per call; an archive or a larger file is refused with where a person uploads it. Every check of the admin's upload holds (type, size, content, the site's quota). A dry run makes the checks with nothing stored. Answers the write with `id`, the file's media id.

- **door**, alone in its batch; class `content` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); no confirmation; dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back; limit: 60 uploads a minute per token, dry runs included; the only way to send `media.add`, `media.replaceBlob`.
- Found by the plain words: "upload", "picture", "image", "photo", "video", "replace", "logo", "favicon".

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `filename` | string (min 1, max 255) | yes |
| `contentType` | string (min 1, max 127) | yes |
| `data` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `replaces` | uuid |  |
| `svgRoles` | object |  |
| `svgRoles` › `text` | string |  |
| `svgRoles` › `accent` | string |  |
| `folderId` | uuid \| null |  |
| `alt` | string (max 1000) \| Record<string, string (max 1000)> |  |
| `caption` | string (max 1000) \| Record<string, string (max 1000)> |  |
| `credit` | string (max 512) |  |

Example input:

```json
{"filename":"team.jpg","contentType":"image/jpeg","data":"<base64>","alt":"The team in the studio","folderId":"<folderId>"}
```
